claim_boundary: Opened-source custom Deform360 calibration study of a target-free guarded uncertainty donor. This is not official Deform360 benchmark parity, a point-accuracy SOTA claim, or confirmation on any target cohort.

source_amendments.reason: The raw robot carrier was CI-private; consume the already sealed 76-frame known-action carrier and omit five unscored tail frames.

The sealed known-action carrier was also CI-private. The registered scoring reconstruction therefore consumes only scoring-panel RGB, calibration, and source-fitted SAM2 masks. Deform360 depth reconstruction supports an absent robot carrier; the URDF gripper-mask stage is omitted and gripper pixels are not explicitly excluded.

source_amendments.failure_stage: Splatfacto initialization after source suffix decode and SAM2 mask generation, before a reconstructed endpoint or source metric existed
source_amendments.reason: The inherited Python 3.12 environment provided a source-only gsplat package without its CUDA backend. Recreate and fail-closed verify the already validated Deform360 Python 3.10, Torch 2.4 CUDA 12.1, precompiled gsplat, and Nerfstudio runtime before any source suffix decode.

source_amendments.failure_stage: SAM2 mask generation before Splatfacto or source metric evaluation
source_amendments.reason: The pinned runtime passed before suffix decode but fewer than three camera masks succeeded. Per-camera exceptions were caught during generation yet omitted from the retained top-level failure artifact. Preserve the frozen mask threshold and add only failure-stage, camera-record, and successful-mask-count diagnostics.

source_amendments.failure_stage: SAM2 video loading before mask inference, Splatfacto, or source metric evaluation
source_amendments.reason: All twelve registered scoring cameras retained the same ModuleNotFoundError for decord. Add the exact decord 0.6.0 video-decoder dependency used by the existing successful SAM2 environment and bind it into the fail-closed runtime identity.

source_amendments.failure_stage: official Warp parity check before scoring-camera suffix decode
source_amendments.reason: The registered source trajectories were generated by Warp 1.16.0, while the auxiliary ensemble runner inherited Warp 1.15.0. Bind Warp 1.16.0 and regenerate every eligible source covariance before it can seal an endpoint. The earlier 1.15.0 smoke metric is exploratory and excluded from the final source gate.

source_amendments.finding: The exact official producer under the pinned Python 3.10 and Warp 1.16 runtime differs from its historical trajectory by 0.290 mm RMSE, while the MatPhys wrapper differs from a fresh official producer run by less than 0.001 mm. Historical-to-current drift is therefore reported as provenance drift, and adapter parity is tested only against a separately constructed current official replay.

source_amendments.reason: The frozen v1 arm retained seven replay-quality passes, one target-free signal-over-floor rejection, and two unavailable physical carriers. Define a new guarded uncertainty policy before opening any additional scoring-camera suffix: use MatPhys covariance only when the existing replay-quality artifact passes, and otherwise use the leave-one-case-out isotropic comparator exactly.

mean.identity_requirement: candidate and comparator use the exact registered float32 C-order bytes and SHA-256

covariance.backend: target-excluded MatPhys 11-fold field ensemble replayed in official PhysTwin Warp with a target-free replay-quality guard
covariance.comparison: leave-one-case-out isotropic Gaussian plus radial split-conformal sphere
covariance.historical_replay_drift_role: reported provenance diagnostic only; excluded from model covariance

selection_policy.matphys_covariance: use only when the sealed replay artifact has passed=true and parity.passed=true
selection_policy.fallback: the exact leave-one-case-out isotropic comparator covariance

outcome.event_estimand: nearest disjoint-view surface displacement for each registered DEFORM mean node

source_gate.failure_action: retain exact DEFORM mean and do not select or process a fresh target cohort
